title: Apply Range Increment Updates
statement: You are given an integer n and a list of updates. Start with an array of length n whose entries are all 0. Each update is a list [start, end, inc] with 0-indexed, inclusive bounds (0 <= start <= end < n); applying it adds inc to every index from start to end. Apply all updates in the given order and return the final array as a list of n integers in index order (index 0 first). If updates is empty, return the all-zeros array of length n.
reference_solution:
def apply_range_updates(n, updates):
    diff = [0] * (n + 1)
    for start, end, inc in updates:
        diff[start] += inc
        diff[end + 1] -= inc
    result = []
    running = 0
    for i in range(n):
        running += diff[i]
        result.append(running)
    return result
hints: Applying each update index-by-index is O(range) per update; can you mark only where a range begins and where it stops instead of touching every element?
Use a difference array: adding inc across [start, end] is equivalent to +inc at start and -inc at end+1, so keep one extra slot at index n to absorb ranges that end at n-1.
Build diff of length n+1, do diff[start] += inc and diff[end+1] -= inc for every update, then sweep a running total left to right, appending the running sum for indices 0..n-1 to your answer.
